zh.title: 聯合航空班機機組員執勤超時　旅客滯留威斯康辛停機坪五小時
zh.summary: 一架聯合航空航班因機組員工時屆滿，旅客受困於威斯康辛州停機坪達五小時。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，聯合航空（United Airlines）發生一起停機坪滯留事件，班機乘客在美國威斯康辛州的地面停機坪上滯留長達五小時。事件起因於客機在地面滑行途中，機組人員因執勤時間屆滿超時，導致航班無法正常進行後續任務。
報導進一步指出，當時客機內部出現物資供應短缺的問題，同時受限於機組人員的執勤時間限制，加上美國海關及邊境保衛局（CBP）相關設施當時處於關閉狀態，多種因素共同影響，致使旅客在停機坪經歷長時間等待。

en.title: United Airlines Passengers Stranded on Wisconsin Tarmac for 5 Hours
en.summary: United Airlines passengers were left stranded on a Wisconsin tarmac for five hours after crew timed out.
body: According to news reports from Simple Flying, passengers on a United Airlines flight were kept waiting on a tarmac in Wisconsin for five hours. The severe delay occurred after the flight crew reached their mandatory duty time limits while taxiing on the ground, leaving the airplane unable to continue its planned movement.

The situation on the Wisconsin tarmac was further impacted by several complicating operational factors. Reports highlighted onboard supply shortages during the five-hour wait, in addition to strict crew duty limits and closed U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) facilities, which together created major difficulties for the affected passengers.

zh.title: 瑞科羅啟動新一代R4豪華經濟艙座椅交付 首批客戶未公開
zh.summary: 瑞科羅開始交付R4豪華經濟艙座椅；預計2026年底前正式投入營運服務。
body: 德國座椅製造商瑞科羅（RECARO Aircraft Seating）確認，已於2026年6月開始向未公開名稱的客戶交付其新一代R4豪華經濟艙座椅。該公司預計，這款全新座椅產品將於2026年底前正式投入商業營運服務。
R4座椅概念最早於2023年在德國漢堡舉行的飛機內裝展（Aircraft Interiors Expo）上首次公開，並於2025年的同場展覽中進行公開展示。日本全日空（All Nippon Airways）在2025年展覽期間宣佈已選擇R4座椅來裝備其豪華經濟艙，不過瑞科羅並未說明該航空公司是否為首發啟動客戶。
瑞科羅將這款新一代產品定位為PL3530座椅的後繼機型。PL3530於2015年推出，並獲多家國際航空公司採用於豪華經濟艙，包含阿聯酋航空、英國航空、國泰航空與星宇航空，拉丁美洲航空（LATAM Airlines）亦選擇該機型用於其即將推出的豪華經濟艙產品。
在人體工學與乘客舒適度方面，R4座椅配備瑞科羅標誌性的六向可調頭枕與內建頸部支撐、側邊氣氛燈、整合閱讀燈的隱私翼，以及便於行動不便旅客（PRM）使用的側邊控制台與軟啟閉超寬餐桌。此外，座椅配有16吋機上娛樂螢幕、智慧型手機與平板電腦支架，並支援多種個人電子設備充電選項。目前R4座椅已取得波音787（Boeing 787）的歐洲技術標準訂單（ETSO）認證，瑞科羅正持續推進其他機型的認證工作。

en.title: RECARO Begins Deliveries of New R4 Premium Economy Seats to Unnamed Customer
en.summary: RECARO Aircraft Seating began delivering its R4 Premium Economy seats in June 2026 ahead of service entry.
body: RECARO Aircraft Seating has confirmed that it officially began delivering its new generation R4 Premium Economy seat to an undisclosed customer in June 2026. According to the German aircraft seat manufacturer, entry into commercial passenger service for the new seat product is expected to occur before the end of 2026.

The R4 seating concept was initially unveiled at the Aircraft Interiors Expo 2023 in Hamburg and subsequently showcased publicly at the 2025 edition of the same industry event. During the 2025 show, All Nippon Airways (ANA) announced that it had selected the R4 seat to equip its Premium Economy cabin, though RECARO's announcement did not clarify whether the Japanese carrier serves as the launch customer for the product.

RECARO is marketing the new generation seat model as the direct successor to its PL3530 seat, which was originally launched in 2015 and has been adopted by several major international airlines introducing Premium Economy cabin offerings. The PL3530 seat is currently in operational service with carriers including Emirates, British Airways, Cathay Pacific, and STARLUX Airlines, and has also been selected by LATAM Airlines for its upcoming Premium Economy cabin product.

Building upon its predecessor, the R4 seat incorporates improvements in ergonomics and passenger comfort, including RECARO's signature six-way adjustable headrest with integrated neck support, side ambient lighting, privacy wings with reading lights, a side console for Passengers with Reduced Mobility (PRM) access, and an extra-wide tray table with a soft open and close mechanism. In terms of inflight entertainment and connectivity features, the seat comes equipped with a 16-inch monitor, an integrated holder for smartphones and tablets, and options to support power for passengers' personal electronic devices. To date, the R4 seat is European Technical Standard Order (ETSO) certified for the Boeing 787 aircraft, while RECARO continues working to secure additional certifications.

zh.title: 民航局推動高雄機場（KHH）新航廈計畫 投入880億元分兩期興建
zh.summary: 民航局投入880.8億元建設高雄機場新航廈；1-2期交通工程已公告招標
body: 交通部民用航空局表示，目前正積極推動高雄機場（KHH）新航廈工程計畫，預計總共投入880.8億元，分兩期建設年旅客容量達1,650萬人次的全新集中式航廈。民航局與工程團隊正全力推進新航廈主體工程的細部設計工作。
新航廈工程採取「先建後拆、半半施工」的方式推進，在維持機場正常營運下進行施工。目前1-1期的東側立體停車場統包工程及A滑行道北移統包工程均在施工中，1-2期的站前交通改善工程也已於7月21日上網公告招標。

en.title: Taiwan CAA Advances Kaohsiung Airport (KHH) Terminal Project with NT$88 Billion Budget
en.summary: Taiwan CAA is advancing Kaohsiung Airport's NT$88.08 billion terminal construction project in two phases.
body: The Civil Aeronautics Administration of Taiwan is advancing the Kaohsiung Airport new terminal project, with a total planned investment of NT$88.08 billion. The project will construct a new centralized terminal in two phases to handle an annual capacity of 16.5 million passengers. The CAA and its engineering teams are currently pushing forward with detailed design work for the main terminal building.

The project is being implemented using a phased approach of building before demolition while maintaining normal airport operations. Phase 1-1 works, including the eastern multi-story parking lot design-build project and the relocation of Taxiway A to the north, are under construction. The tender for Phase 1-2 station front traffic improvement project was posted on July 21.
